name: Wicked Alliance
body:
You forgot to tell your new friend about one thing: Just how expendable they were.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 13, Diplomacy 5 ranks

Benefit(s): You may gain a +4 bonus on a single attack roll or skill check made against a friendly target. This action cannot be one that benefits the target. If you do so, the target immediately becomes unfriendly (in the case of a non-combat action) or hostile (in the case of an attack action).
